checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Entire original clip plays before end card, unchanged
must.why: Only a separate 2s card was delivered. The user chose that option, but the output is not a combined video.

must.item: Solid black end card occupies only final 2 s of 9 s output
must.why: No 9 s output exists. Only a standalone 2 s black card, so the card is not appended to the clip.

must.item: Reads exactly 'Ready for takeoff?' with '@flightschool' below
must.why: Both lines are spelled correctly, with the handle below the title.

must.item: Both lines white, centered, fully visible, readable
must.why: White bold text is centered on black. The handle is smaller but still readable.

must.item: Original audio preserved then silence during end card
must.why: No combined output. The card clip is silent and the original audio was not joined.

faults.what: No combined video. The original clip and the end card are not joined, so the user must join them in an editor.
The card is 864x474, which may not match the source resolution. It is also very slightly soft or noisy in the video frames.
The handle line is small relative to the title.

summary: The standalone 2 s black end card has correct, white, centered text, but it is not joined to the clip, so the user must append it themselves.
